tables.name: Docks District Additional Locations
tables.description: Rolled for each additional location of a Docks district (Very Small 1 … Very Large 5 per district). 1 and 20: roll again, the next location a step down or up in quality.

results.name: Roll Again (a step down in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step down in quality.

results.name: Cooper
results.description: (Basic) Crafts wooden vessels held together with metal hoops, including barrels, buckets, etc.

results.name: Carpenter
results.description: (Basic) Builds with or carves wood, as well as carrying out repairs.

results.name: Smithy
results.description: (Basic) Sells and crafts metal tools and equipment, including very basic weapons and armor.

results.name: Bank & Exchange
results.description: (Specialty) Encompasses auctions, banking, and the specific selling of gems or exchange of currency.

results.name: Shipwright
results.description: (Specialty) Builds and launches boats and/or ships.

results.name: Rare Botanicals
results.description: (Exotic) Cultivates and sells herbs rare to the region.

results.name: Rare Libations and Fare
results.description: (Exotic) Sells (and, perhaps, makes or brews) drinks and/or food of surpassing quality or rarity to the region.

results.name: Rare Trade Goods
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells items and materials, such as ores or textiles, that are rare to the region.

results.name: Magic Shop
results.description: (Exotic) A magic shop; its specialization is rolled.

results.name: Barber
results.description: Provides grooming services, such as haircuts or shaves.

results.name: Bathhouse
results.description: Provides spaces for bathing.

results.name: Doctor/Apothecary
results.description: Provides medical care.

results.name: House of Leisure
results.description: Provides entertainment and/or relaxation (GM may decide what kind).

results.name: Inn
results.description: Provides accommodation, as well as a place to have a bath and a decent meal.

results.name: Club
results.description: Provides entertainment via comedic, dramatic or musical performance.

results.name: Tavern
results.description: Provides food and drink.

results.name: Hired Help
results.description: Hired help; its kind is rolled (1d10), then its size.

results.name: Altar
results.description: (Non-commercial) A small shrine or, perhaps, a tiny shack, usually evincing some various items or images relating to that which the faith venerates.

results.name: Roll Again (a step up in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step up in quality.
